traditions.VUL: Fuit autem Ezechías dives , et ínclytus valde ,
traditions.KJV: And Hezekiah had exceeding much riches and honour :

27.english_reference: and he made himself treasuries for silver , and for gold , and for precious stones , and for spices , and for shields , and for all manner of pleasant jewels ;

traditions.WLC: וְ אֹֽצָר֣וֹת עָֽשָׂה ל֠ וֹ לְ כֶ֨סֶף וּ לְ זָהָ֜ב וּ לְ אֶ֣בֶן יְקָרָ֗ה וְ לִ בְשָׂמִים֙ וּ לְ מָ֣גִנִּ֔ים וּ לְ כֹ֖ל כְּלֵ֥י חֶמְדָּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ θησαυροὺς ἐποίησεν αὐτῷ ἀργυρίου καὶ χρυσίου καὶ τοῦ λίθου τοῦ τιμίου , καὶ εἰς τὰ ἀρώματα καὶ ὁπλοθήκας καὶ εἰς σκευη ἐπιθυμητά ,
traditions.VUL: et thesáuros sibi plúrimos congregávit argénti , et auri , et lápidis pretiósi , arómatum , et armórum univérsi géneris , et vasórum magni prétii .
traditions.KJV: and he made himself treasuries for silver , and for gold , and for precious stones , and for spices , and for shields , and for all manner of pleasant jewels ;

28.english_reference: Storehouses also for the increase of corn , and wine , and oil ;

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ֨סְכְּנ֔וֹת לִ תְבוּאַ֥ת דָּגָ֖ן וְ תִיר֣וֹשׁ וְ יִצְהָ֑ר
traditions.LXX: καὶ πόλεις εἰς τὰ γενήματα σίτου καὶ ἐλαίου καὶ οἴνου ,
traditions.VUL: Apothécas quoque fruménti , vini , et ólei ,
traditions.KJV: Storehouses also for the increase of corn , and wine , and oil ;

28.english_reference: and stalls for all manner of beasts , and cotes for flocks .

traditions.WLC: וְ אֻֽרָוֺת֙ לְ כָל בְּהֵמָ֣ה וּ בְהֵמָ֔ה וַ עֲדָרִ֖ים לָ אֲוֵרֽוֹת
traditions.LXX: καὶ φάτνας παντὸς κτήνους καὶ μάνδρας εἰς τὰ ποίμνια ,
traditions.VUL: et præsépia ómnium iumentórum , caulásque pécorum ,
traditions.KJV: and stalls for all manner of beasts , and cotes for flocks .

29.english_reference: Moreover he provided him cities , and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance :

traditions.WLC: וְ עָרִים֙ עָ֣שָׂה ל֔ וֹ וּ מִקְנֵה צֹ֥אן וּ בָקָ֖ר לָ רֹ֑ב
traditions.LXX: καὶ πόλεις ἃς ᾠκοδόμησεν αὐτῷ καὶ ἀποσκευὴν προβάτων καὶ βοῶν εἰς πλῆθος ,
traditions.VUL: et urbes ædificávit sibi : habébat quippe greges óvium , et armentórum innumerábiles ,
traditions.KJV: Moreover he provided him cities , and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance :

29.english_reference: for God had given him substance very much .

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י נָֽתַן ל וֹ֙ אֱלֹהִ֔ים רְכ֖וּשׁ רַ֥ב מְאֹֽד
traditions.LXX: ὅτι ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ Κύριος ἀποσκευὴν πολλὴν σφόδρα .
traditions.VUL: eo quod dedísset ei Dóminus substántiam multam nimis .
traditions.KJV: for God had given him substance very much .

30.english_reference: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon , and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David .

traditions.WLC: וְ ה֣וּא יְחִזְקִיָּ֗הוּ סָתַם֙ אֶת מוֹצָ֞א מֵימֵ֤י גִיחוֹן֙ הָֽ עֶלְי֔וֹן וַֽ יַּישְּׁרֵ֥ ם לְ מַֽטָּה מַּעְרָ֖בָ ה לְ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑יד
traditions.LXX: αὐτὸς Ἑζεκίας ἐνέφραξεν τὴν ἔξοδον τοῦ ὕδατος Σειὼν τὸ ἄνω , καὶ κατηύθυνεν αὐτὰ κάτω πρὸς λίβα τῆς πόλεως Δαυείδ ·
traditions.VUL: Ipse est Ezechías , qui obturávit superiórem fontem aquárum Gihon , et avértit eas subter ad occidéntem urbis David :
traditions.KJV: This same Hezekiah also stopped the upper watercourse of Gihon , and brought it straight down to the west side of the city of David .

30.english_reference: And Hezekiah prospered in all his works .

traditions.WLC: וַ יַּצְלַ֥ח יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ בְּ כָֽל מַעֲשֵֽׂ הוּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ εὐοδώθη Ἑζεκίας ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἔργοις αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: in ómnibus opéribus suis fecit próspere quæ vóluit .
traditions.KJV: And Hezekiah prospered in all his works .

31.english_reference: Howbeit in [ the business of ] the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon

traditions.WLC: וְ כֵ֞ן בִּ מְלִיצֵ֣י שָׂרֵ֣י בָּבֶ֗ל
traditions.LXX: καὶ οὕτως τοῖς πρεσβύταις τῶν ἀρχόντων ἀπὸ Βαβυλῶνος
traditions.VUL: Attamen in legatióne príncipum Babylónis ,
traditions.KJV: Howbeit in [ the business of ] the ambassadors of the princes of Babylon ,

31.english_reference: who sent unto him to inquire of the wonder that was [ done ] in the land

traditions.WLC: הַֽ מְשַׁלְּחִ֤ים עָלָי ו֙ לִ דְרֹ֗שׁ הַ מּוֹפֵת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיָ֣ה בָ אָ֔רֶץ
traditions.LXX: τοῖς ἀποσταλεῖσιν πρὸς αὐτὸν πυθέσθαι παρ᾽ αὐτοῦ τὸ τέρας ὃ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ,
traditions.VUL: qui missi fúerant ad eum , ut interrogárent de porténto , quod accíderat super terram ,
traditions.KJV: who sent unto him to inquire of the wonder that was [ done ] in the land ,

traditions.WLC: עֲזָב֖ וֹ הָֽ אֱלֹהִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: ἐγκατέλιπεν αὐτὸν Κύριος
traditions.VUL: derelíquit eum Deus
traditions.KJV: God left him ,

traditions.WLC: לְ נַ֨סּוֹת֔ וֹ
traditions.LXX: τοῦ πειράσαι αὐτόν ,
traditions.VUL: ut tentarétur ,
traditions.KJV: to try him ,

31.english_reference: that he might know all [ that was ] in his heart

traditions.WLC: לָ דַ֖עַת כָּל בִּ לְבָבֽ וֹ
traditions.LXX: εἰδέναι τὰ ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ .
traditions.VUL: et nota fíerent ómnia , quæ erant in corde eius .
traditions.KJV: that he might know all [ that was ] in his heart .

32.english_reference: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah , and his goodness

traditions.WLC: וְ יֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י יְחִזְקִיָּ֖הוּ וַ חֲסָדָ֑י
traditions.VUL: Réliqua autem sermónum Ezechíæ , et misericordiárum eius ,
traditions.KJV: Now the rest of the acts of Hezekiah , and his goodness ,

32.english_reference: behold , they [ are ] written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet , the son of Amoz

traditions.WLC: ו הִנָּ֣ ם כְּתוּבִ֗ים בַּ חֲז֞וֹן יְשַֽׁעְיָ֤הוּ בֶן אָמוֹץ֙ הַ נָּבִ֔יא
traditions.VUL: scripta sunt in visióne Isaíæ fílii Amos prophétæ ,
traditions.KJV: behold , they [ are ] written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet , the son of Amoz , [ and ]

32.english_reference: [and] in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel

traditions.WLC: עַל סֵ֥פֶר מַלְכֵי יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל
traditions.VUL: et in Libro regum Iuda et Israel .
traditions.KJV: in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel .

33.english_reference: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers

traditions.WLC: וַ יִּשְׁכַּ֨ב יְחִזְקִיָּ֜הוּ עִם אֲבֹתָ֗י
traditions.VUL: Dormivítque Ezechías cum pátribus suis ,
traditions.KJV: And Hezekiah slept with his fathers ,

33.english_reference: and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David

traditions.WLC: ו וַֽ יִּקְבְּרֻ הוּ֮ בְּֽ מַעֲלֵה֮ קִבְרֵ֣י בְנֵי דָוִיד֒
traditions.VUL: et sepeliérunt eum super sepúlcra filiórum David :
traditions.KJV: and they buried him in the chiefest of the sepulchres of the sons of David :

33.english_reference: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death

traditions.WLC: וְ כָבוֹד֙ עָֽשׂוּ ל֣ וֹ בְ מוֹת֔ וֹ כָּל יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ יֹשְׁבֵ֣י יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם
traditions.VUL: et celebrávit eius exséquias univérsus Iuda , et omnes habitatóres Ierúsalem :
traditions.KJV: and all Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem did him honour at his death .

33.english_reference: And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead

traditions.VUL: regnavítque Manásses fílius eius pro eo .
traditions.KJV: And Manasseh his son reigned in his stead .
